verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at cursor.com/llms.txt that indexes markdown docs, plus an agent-readable markdown version of the Bugbot docs at cursor.com/docs/bugbot.md, so an agent can be pointed directly at them. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/markdown docs for agent use, evidence of a Bugbot-specific section or full-text (llms-full.txt) variant.
